jobs.details: ROLE SUMMARY: The Tender Specialist – Gulf supports the Tender Lead – Middle East in delivering revenue and IBA improvement for the Tender & Contracts (T&C) business across Gulf markets. The role owns the day-to-day preparation, documentation and submission of tenders and RFQs, including UAE daily RFQs, coordinates inputs from country and above-country stakeholders, maintains accurate and audit-ready tender records, and tracks awards and contract obligations through to fulfillment, providing analysis and insights that strengthen tender commitments and bid competitiveness. CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. TENDER PIPELINE & OPPORTUNITY TRACKING Maintain the Gulf tender calendar and opportunity tracker covering upcoming bids, renewals, deadlines, milestones and dependencies. Review incoming tender requests and RFQs for requirements, eligibility, specifications and timelines, and flag risks early to the Tender Lead. Prepare opportunity summaries using historical performance, pricing, supply feasibility and regulatory status to support bid / no-bid decisions. Handle UAE daily RFQs, ensuring timely responses aligned with approved pricing and supply availability. 2. TENDER PREPARATION, DOCUMENTATION & SUBMISSION Prepare and submit complete, accurate and compliant tender documents, ensuring all technical, commercial and administrative requirements are met. Coordinate and follow up on inputs from Regulatory, Supply, Access & Pricing, Medical, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Legal and distributors, as applicable. Manage bid documentation, version control, bid bonds, samples, certificates and supporting documents within agreed timelines. jobs.details: ROLE SUMMARY Pharmaceutical pricing in Egypt, the Levant and Iraq is evolving quickly, with growing use of international reference pricing, pricing steps linked to product registration, and price adjustments driven by policy and exchange-rate changes. The Pricing Manager leads the day-to-day execution of pricing for these markets, in line with regional pricing strategy and governance. Based in Cairo, the role prepares and manages pricing submissions, maintains pricing records and analytics, provides pricing input to tenders and access plans, and works closely with Regulatory, Finance, Commercial and market access colleagues as well as local distribution partners. CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. EGYPT PRICING Prepare pricing simulations, submissions and repricing responses in line with local pricing regulations; monitor reference-price movements and flag potential impacts early. Maintain accurate pricing records and a complete audit trail for all pricing activities. 2. LEVANT AND IRAQ PRICE APPROVALS Prepare and follow up pricing submissions and price-list updates for Iraq, Jordan and Lebanon, working with local distribution partners and in line with regional pricing guidance. Monitor exchange-rate and policy changes affecting prices and recommend appropriate actions. 3. TENDER AND ACCESS PRICING SUPPORT Provide pricing analysis and recommendations to support tenders, national programs and market access plans, within agreed pricing guidelines. 4. GOVERNANCE AND ANALYTICS Manage pricing governance and approval workflows; produce regular pricing reports and reference-price analyses. Support new product launches with pricing and launch-sequencing analysis. 5.
